content.name: Hunter's Mark
entries: You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra {@damage 1d6} damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack, and you have advantage on any Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) or Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check you make to find it. If the target drops to 0 hit points before this spell ends, you can use a bonus action on a subsequent turn of yours to mark a new creature.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd or 4th level, you can maintain your {@status concentration} on the spell for up to 8 hours. When you use a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can maintain your {@status concentration} on the spell for up to 24 hours.

content.name: Hunter's Mark
entries: You magically mark one creature you can see within range as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra {@damage 1d6} Force damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on any Wisdom ({@skill Perception|SRD52} or {@skill Survival|SRD52}) check you make to find it.
If the target drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} before this spell ends, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to move the mark to a new creature you can see within range.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Your {@status Concentration|SRD52} can last longer with a spell slot of level 3-4 (up to 8 hours) or 5+ (up to 24 hours).
